goals.notes: Height-field sources for Shader Garden's terrain material channel — mixed relief (smooth hills through eroded plateau) so the garden has more than one biome to draw texture-blend channels from. Evolved from terrain_kernel's Hurst-exponent oracle, not hand-authored.

General-purpose evolved noise(vec3) generators for the garden's procedural texture library. Scored against noise_kernel's spectral/statistical oracle (not a visual pass) — fitness reflects statistical fidelity to the target noise class, not curated 'looks nice' selection.

Showcase-quality evolved SDFs in the gyroid family (periodic/organic minimal-surface style, plus two structurally related instances: a domain-warped sphere and a smooth-union composite) for the garden's front-page rotation. Lower priority than the two channel/texture goals — showcase pieces are a nice-to-have, not a garden dependency.
